title: Staff of Arcane Blessing

sources.title: Bless
markers: | description = Bless up to 3 creatures. They gain a {{DieIcon|d4|Slashing}} '''+1d4''' bonus to {{Attack Roll}}s and {{SavingThrow}}s.

sources.title: Mystra's Blessing
markers: | description = Creatures you {{SmSAI|Bless}} also gain [[Mystra's Blessing (Staff of Arcane Blessing) (condition)|Mystra's Blessing]] for an additional 1d4 bonus to spell attack rolls.{{see bugs}}

summary: Casts Bless and augments certain Bless castings with Mystra’s Blessing.

fields.Weapon profile: Simple, Versatile, 5 ft melee, Dippable. 1d6 one-handed or 1d8 two-handed Bludgeoning plus Strength.
fields.Bless: Level 1, Action, 30 ft, 3 creatures, concentration up to 10 turns, once per Long Rest. Adds 1d4 to attacks and saves.
fields.Mystra’s Blessing: Adds another 1d4 to spell attacks for 10 turns when cast from the staff or a level 1 or 2 slot. That extra die can persist after concentration on ordinary Bless ends.
fields.Acquisition: Arcane Tower basement. Guiding Light reveals the teleporter button.
fields.Topple: With proficiency, once per Short Rest. Action, weapon attack for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. DEX save against weapon-action DC +2 or Prone for 1 turn. Prone breaks Concentration and expires at the start of the target’s turn. Topple skips main-hand weapon effects.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
